chose: The phone drains one lane to home at a time; a screen's read or Sync runs beside that run, but lanes never run beside each other.
gray: Concurrent lanes would empty a backlog sooner, but the lanes share a read-then-write of what was sent, which would need reworking first.
undo: Let the drain side in model.ts admit more than one run, after making the shared `sent` write safe under concurrency.
